about.title: About
about.about-me: Write some information about yourself that is IT related. Why are you passionate about coding? What is your source of inspiration for improving your programming skills?
about.lets-connect: Let's connect and create something amazing together!

list.location: Where are you located? Are you open to different ways of working, such as working remotely or even relocating?
list.learning: Show that you are open-minded. Are you enthusiastic about learning new technologies and continually improving your skills?
list.problem-solving: A brief description of your problem-solving approach. Do you learn from each challenge as you search for the most efficient or elegant solution? You can include some keywords like: analytical thinking, creativity, persistence and  collaboration.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.

projects.pollo-loco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-orientated approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.pokedex: Based on the PokéAPI a simple library that provides and catalogues pokemon information.

references.schuster: Michael really kept the team together with his great organization and clear communication. We wouldn't have got this far without his commitment.
references.eichinger: Michi was a top team colleague at DA. His positive commitment and willingness to take on responsibility made a significant contribution to us achieving our goals.
references.nuber: It was a great pleasure to work with Michael. He knows how to push and encourage team members to present the best work possible, always adding something to brainstorm. Regarding the well-being of group members, he was always present and available to listen and help others, with a great sense of humor as well.

contact.title: Contact

contact.why-contact: Encourage people to contact you and describe what role you are interested in. Show that you will add value to their projects through your work.
